data.title: 泽塔 · 祭典摊位的伪装
data.description: 祭典上，泽塔系着法披守着射击摊位，面无表情地给小客人递枪。没人知道，这个摊位正对着教团联络点的后门。
data.location: summer festival street with a shooting game stall and paper lanterns
data.action: standing behind a festival game stall handing a toy rifle to a child, deadpan expression, happi coat
data.lighting: 祭典灯笼的暖光与暮色
data.promptProse: Behind a festival shooting stall, Zeta hands out prizes with a straight face — and watches the cult's back door.
data.animaCaption: Prizes for the children, eyes on the enemy. Zeta's cover is perfect, her face perfectly bored.
